title: Quarterly account review
contextText: Quarterly review of all accounts with Hazel and Pia. Not recorded.

note.body:
# Quarterly account review

**Date:** May 28
**Attendees:** Alma Mockwell (Larkspur Labs), Hazel Placeholder (Larkspur Labs), Pia Sample (Larkspur Labs)

## Summary

Quarterly review of every Larkspur Labs client account, covering revenue, staffing and risk. Alma reports to Hazel for account matters, so Hazel chaired.

## Accounts

- **Org Lambda Robotics** — the strongest account this quarter. Lambda account revenue is up 30 percent over plan, driven by the pilot extension to Building 5.
- **Halden Freight** — the migration continues without Rafferty; JD now owns the depot integrations. The southern depots cutover is planned for June.
- **Corvid Health** — designs are signed off and the build is starting at the first walk-in clinic.
- **Solvane Energy** — integration kickoff went well; demo targeted for early July.
- **Gullwing Payments** — the discovery gate is close; Florian wants numbers before the build decision.
- **Varden Insurance** — discovery is under way; Rhea will be out for two weeks in June.

## Decisions

- Larkspur **will not bid on Varden's phase two infrastructure work**; the team lacks the mainframe skills and Hazel does not want to subcontract it.
- The hiring freeze is over; Pia can open two engineering reqs.

## Staffing

- Hazel becomes a partner at Larkspur Labs from July. The announcement goes out internally next week.
- Pia will be on medical leave for two weeks in July. JD covers engineering management while she is out.

## Action items

- **Hazel Placeholder** — draft the Q3 staffing plan by June 10, including cover for Pia's leave.
- **Pia Sample** — open two engineering reqs this week.
- **Alma Mockwell** — prepare a one-page account health summary for the partner meeting.

## Risks

- Lambda now represents a large share of revenue; Hazel wants a second anchor client before the end of the year.
